proposition: The R. Shaqq-i Qamar presents itself as a response to a popular debate among traditionists and theologians over the splitting of the moon, framed as the author's journey through the marketplaces of the sciences; this frame is literary and is not evidence of a particular event.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, paraphrasing or translating Ibn Turka's own work
mediation.note: 'upon a day … traveled the length and breadth of the engendered realm' is a conventional literary frame
